title: How Romàn Czerny used cold email to book demos and grow Goji Berry to $2.5M
summary: Romàn explains his cold email playbook: validate the market by booking demos before building, then turn outbound into inbound by offering a blueprint instead of asking for a call. He covers lead quality, volume, deliverability rules and why 1% reply rates still pay off.

principles.text: Use cold email to test the market and book demos before you build the product.
principles.quote: the goal here is to book as many demos as you can before building the product. So you can talk to your core audience. You try to sell them something and if they agree or if they ask okay what's the price then there might be something to do
